nl: 用 Ant Design Vue 做服务台工单：查询有工单号、处理状态（待处理/处理中/已完成）；表格展示工单号、标题、处理状态、创建时间；支持新增、编辑、删除。后端返回 { result: [...], count: N }。
nlEn: Ant Design Vue service-desk tickets: query by ticket no and status (pending/in-progress/done); the table shows ticket no, title, status, and created time; supports add, edit, and delete. The backend returns { result: [...], count: N }.
notes: AI-08: { result, count } mapping on the antdv target (antdv/schema)
